theme: La rutina del día y el cuerpo — los verbos reflexivos, la rutina en detalle, el cuerpo y la salud, y doler
storyThread: La curación del leproso (Marcos 1:41). L1 = los verbos reflexivos: me levanto, me lavo, me visto (la persona). L2 = la rutina en detalle: por la mañana / por la noche, el orden del día. L3 = el cuerpo. L4 = la salud, el dolor y doler: «Me duele la cabeza.»
grammarTargets: reflexive verbs: the pronoun is part of the id (me levanto, not levanto + a separate me) — the me gusta (a0-verbs) and me llamo (unit-01) precedent; me/te/se are never standalone ids

the levantarse person paradigm in ONE wave (me levanto / te levantas / se levanta / nos levantamos — the a1-u02 tener and a1-u03 ir paradigm precedent); se levantan deliberately excluded (C7 precedent) → A1-U8 deferred list

doler works like gustar: the body part is the SUBJECT and the person is the PRONOUN (me duele la cabeza = the head hurts me). Three pronoun phrases bound (me duele, te duele, le duele); duelen excluded (the duele/duelen minimal pair, tiene/tienen family) → A2-U2
body parts take the DEFINITE ARTICLE, not the possessive (me lavo la cara, me duele la cabeza) — taught by note + say, no new ids
present tense ONLY — pretérito is A1-U7; no subjunctive; affirmative familiar imperatives only (toca, abre — a1-u03 precedent). The scripture passage is exempt per the standing scripture ruling
tenemos lands here (C7 DISCHARGED: a1-u02 excluded it to A1-U5/U8; U8 owes no second serve — vas and cuestan still do)
waveNotes: l1 (9) = the reflexive verbs, all new: the levantarse person paradigm + five routine verbs. The paradigm sits in ONE wave (a1-u02 tener and a1-u03 ir precedent) with its members NEVER sharing a hear-choose set (one-letter pairs, C5); the person contrast is tested in gap-fill with the written subject (E6 precedent). se levantan deliberately absent → A1-U8. l2 (9) = the routine in detail: 2 byte-identical re-passes (mañana, noche — a0-u01/unit-01.json) + 7 new. después/primero sit together on purpose (the order pair IS the teaching point, caro/barato precedent). l3 (10) = the body, all new: cuerpo/cabeza/cara/ojo/boca/mano/brazo/pierna/pie/corazón. ojo + mano close a0-u02's unbound spoken form «Dos ojos, dos manos» (F5 hole in reverse). corazón is F9 UNBLOCKED (bindable in U6 with 1 Sam 16:7, not bound here). l4 (8) = health/doler: enfermo/sano (opposite pair, kept), médico, dolor + the doler paradigm (me duele/te duele/le duele — the pronoun phrases MAY share a set, mi/tu/su precedent), leproso (the story's own word). Largest wave = 10 — under the 12-per-page threshold (DEFECTS #18), no pagination. Wave 5 = adaptive replay from progress.misses (unchanged convention).

qna.nearFormRule: Never in the same hear-choose option set — INHERITED and still binding: cómo/como, vivo/vive, cree/crece/creó, por qué/porque, muro/pared, mi/mío, tu/tú, tiene/tienen, tienes/tiene, en/entre, nuevo/nuestro (a1-u02); va/van, ve/ven, ve/va, a/al, pueblo/puerta/puente, plaza/plato/planta, barro/burro, barro/carro, viaje/viejo, camello/camino, cruza/crece/cree, espera/escribe, cama/casa (a1-u03); mercader/mercado, esta/está, este/esta/esto/estos/estas, estos/estas, ese/esa, ese/este, camisa/cama, barato/barro, color/calor, verde/verano, rojo/ropa, cuesta/cuántos, cinturón/cintas (a1-u04). NEW IN THIS PACK: the levantarse paradigm — me levanto/te levantas/se levanta/nos levantamos NEVER share a hear-choose set (one-letter pairs, C5); tengo/tenemos (teng- stem); me llamo (unit-01)/me lavo/me levanto (me l- cluster); me visto/vestido (a1-u04); mano/mañana; mano/hermano; cara/casa; cara/cama; pierna/piedra; pie/pierna/piedra; siempre/nunca (polarity). DOCUMENTED EXCEPTIONS (deliberate, kept): (1) the taught contrast sets sit TOGETHER — enfermo/sano, cena/desayuno, después/primero, cuerpo/cabeza/mano, dolor/me duele (the precio/cuesta precedent); (2) the doler paradigm me duele/te duele/le duele MAY share a hear-choose set (mi/tu/su precedent) — the pronoun IS the contrast, while the levantarse paradigm may NOT (Reviewer call U5-7 recorded); (3) the day's three ends (me despierto/me levanto/me acuesto) share sets (semantic set, not a near pair); (4) a1-u02's hay/está/tengo, mi/tu/su, cuántos/cuándo exceptions remain documented; hay/está appear here only as tenemos's decoys. NOT IDS, therefore NEVER option strings (phantom decoy, DEFECTS #14): tarde, a veces, almuerzo, nariz, medicina, fiebre, diente, pelo, duelen, lepra, sanó, primer, médica, enferma, sana, sanas, ojos, pies, rutina, desayuno/cena as VERBS, me/te/se/nos standalone, levantar/lavar/vestir/peinar/acostar/despertar infinitives.

qna.grammar: A1 register per THEOLOGY-guide §3.1: PRESENT TENSE ONLY — pretérito is A1-U7; no subjunctive; affirmative familiar imperatives only (toca, abre); no negative commands, no vosotros. The reflexive pronoun is bound inside the id — me/te/se are never standalone ids (me gusta precedent). Every say is one idea and the target word is repeated in caption + sign. Scripture is exempt from the tense rule (standing ruling).
qna.csa: Owner plain-truth directive applied: nothing softened, nothing added. The leper is sick and asks for help; the healing is rendered as the Gospels render it — compassion, a hand, a touch, a word — with no invented detail, no gore, and no dramatization beyond the text. Sickness and pain are named plainly (enfermo, dolor, me duele). No line interprets illness as punishment or as a measure of faith (CK-11), and the pack makes no claim about why the man was sick. INT-1 holds — no doctrine-assent gate anywhere.
qna.formIdRule: ids are the exact form the learner hears and the string on the tile. Reflexive verbs are FINITE forms WITH the pronoun — exactly as me gusta (a0-verbs) and me llamo (unit-01); me/te/se are never standalone ids. doler binds as three pronoun phrases with the body part in say/sign (the ¿Cuánto cuesta? phrase-vs-word precedent). Body parts are SINGULAR citation forms with plurals in say/reading only (moneda precedent). Adverbs are bare; the routine phrases live in say/sign.
